title: In-Depth Look Into Each Form Field Type
text:
## In-Depth Look Into Each Form Field Type
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000059648

## What Are Field Types?
The Field Type setting determines how a form field displays on the front end.
Field types can be found under Edit View for any form:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12110314650/original/ffNJDym9_RpFAQjKCQBx0yxhm93f31p8HQ.png?1655225916 | alt: ]

## Select Fields

## Checkboxes
To add options to a checkbox field, click Add Option .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12095102871/original/J7oZ7a6I-CuzZmYnzjYkYNjrMtq555pxSg.png?1625581565 | alt: ]
Specify the option display name and database variable. The database variable is created automatically but can be edited if needed.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12095103087/original/v8p8ykKsIH5qmg57NpyUOvcsG68NnNuWrg.gif?1625581719 | alt: ]
Front-end view:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12095103222/original/_AZyytWQcrQa-T6gTaDpq1BZuYeFfCs1OQ.png?1625581837 | alt: ]

## Drop-down List
The same logic used for checkboxes applies to drop-down lists.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12095103383/original/HfKaLs5AomDtOj3zPfCOJZT7lNmx_Ajq-g.png?1625581985 | alt: ]
Front-end view:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12095103297/original/_x8bQGKn1GZqiupxt9932aRYE2edpvzxOA.png?1625581909 | alt: ]

## Multiple Choice Radios
The same logic used for checkboxes applies to radio buttons.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12095103496/original/S_d0P3EZ2D02FchkYfNb85XHFn9E2CvrbA.png?1625582071 | alt: ]

## Yes or No
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090919347/original/PMtqfpjmTpsyJeq89OCt5gHhTuuHsOvRbQ.png?1617673736 | alt: ]
Important Note: For all select-type fields (Checkboxes, Radio Buttons, and Drop-down Lists), keyword searches will match the saved field label content.

## File Upload Field
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12108766001/original/GqrI0vW-SHnUfjQ3nb0AFl1S_IZhqI4KuQ.png?1652201707 | alt: ]
Important:
Maximum file size: 10 MB
Default availability: Listing – Additional Details – Member form
This field can be used on other forms with the File Uploads for Forms add-on.
